description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP driver for the Advantage Database Server (ADS) within the ADOdb abstraction layer. It defines classes for database connection handling, executing queries, managing transactions, and retrieving metadata specific to ADS.

classes.name: ADODB_ads
classes.description: Main driver class for connecting to and interacting with Advantage Database Server, including connection management, transaction control, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_ads class, initializes the connection object.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the ADS database using provided Data Source Name, username, and password.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the ADS database.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server version and description information from the ADS server.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence (table with autoincrement) in the database.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops a sequence (table) from the database.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new ID by inserting into or retrieving from a sequence table.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the latest error message from the ADS driver.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the latest error number from the ADS driver.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about tables and views.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key information for a given table.

methods.name: ODBCTypes
methods.description: Maps ODBC data type codes to internal type strings.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves detailed metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: MetaColumnNames
methods.description: Retrieves column names for a specified table.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, optionally using bindings.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement, with support for prepared statements and input arrays.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in a table with binary data.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the current database connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ads
classes.description: Represents a record set retrieved from an ADS query, providing methods for fetching data, seeking, and managing the result set.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the recordset with a given query ID and fetch mode.

methods.name: FetchField
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a specific field.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Accesses field data by column name or index.

methods.name: _initrs
methods.description: Initializes row and column metadata for the recordset.

methods.name: _seek
methods.description: Attempts to seek to a specific row (not supported in this driver).

methods.name: GetArrayLimit
methods.description: Returns a limited set of rows as an array for faster data fetching.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the pointer to the next row in the result set.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches the current row into the fields array.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Frees the result set resources.
